name: OM-1.2-3B-Base
description: Large native OM decoder-only Transformer architecture for a fresh pretraining run. Architecture only: these settings do not represent trained or GPT-level weights.
parameter_goal_note: The repository ModelConfig estimator predicts about 2.999B parameters. Verify with model-info and the actual OMTransformer constructor before training. This is an untrained architecture preset, not a checkpoint. A Mac mini may support experiments, but training a useful model at this scale from scratch is compute- and data-intensive.
